import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoo i j = uIoo (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoo]

/-!
### `Fin.natAdd`
-/

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

  range_natAdd m n

    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]

@[simp]

  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by

    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

  range_natAdd m n

    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]

  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoo i j = uIoo (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoo]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoo i j = uIoo (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoo]

  (finCongr h).image_eq_preimage _

theorem image_cast_fun (h : m = n) : image (Fin.cast h) = preimage (Fin.cast h.symm) :=
  funext <| image_cast h

/-!
### `Fin.natAdd`
-/

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

    ext

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoo i j = uIoo (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoo]

/-!
### `Fin.natAdd`
-/

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by

  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioo (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioo i j = Ioo (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]

theorem range_natAdd (m n : ℕ) : range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = {i | m ≤ i.1} := by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ici (m n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ici (natAdd m 0) :=
  range_natAdd m n

theorem range_natAdd_eq_Ioi (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] :

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]

@[simp]

  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]

    apply le_coe_natAdd
  · refine fun (hi : m ≤ i) ↦ ⟨⟨i - m, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    simp [hi]

  range_natAdd m n

    range (natAdd m : Fin n → Fin (m + n)) = Ioi (castAdd n ⊤) := by
  ext ⟨_, _⟩
  simp [range_natAdd, lt_def, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by

@[simp]

  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ico (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ico i j = Ico (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ico_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioc i j = Ioc (i : ℕ) j := by

  rw [← preimage_val_Ioo_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]
@[simp] theorem image_val_uIoc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIoc i j = uIoc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIoc]

import Mathlib.Order.Fin.Basic

import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.UnorderedInterval

/-!
# (Pre)images of set intervals under `Fin` operations

In this file we prove basic lemmas about preimages and images of the intervals
under the following operations:

- `Fin.val`,
- `Fin.castLE` (preimages only),
- `Fin.castAdd`,
- `Fin.cast`,
- `Fin.castSucc`,
- `Fin.natAdd`,
- `Fin.addNat`,
- `Fin.succ`,
- `Fin.rev`.
-/

open Function Set

namespace Fin

variable {m n : ℕ}

/-!
### (Pre)images under `Fin.val`
-/

@[simp]
theorem range_val : range ((↑) : Fin n → ℕ) = Set.Iio n := by ext; simp [Fin.exists_iff]

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ici_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ici (i : ℕ) = Ici i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioi_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioi (i : ℕ) = Ioi i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iic_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iic (i : ℕ) = Iic i := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Iio_val (i : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Iio (i : ℕ) = Iio i := rfl

@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Icc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Icc (i : ℕ) j = Icc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ico_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ico (i : ℕ) j = Ico i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioc (i : ℕ) j = Ioc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_Ioo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' Ioo (i : ℕ) j = Ioo i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIcc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIcc (i : ℕ) j = uIcc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoc_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoc (i : ℕ) j = uIoc i j := rfl
@[simp] theorem preimage_val_uIoo_val (i j : Fin n) : (↑) ⁻¹' uIoo (i : ℕ) j = uIoo i j := rfl

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ici (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ici i = Ico (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ici_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ici_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iic (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iic i = Iic (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iic_val, image_preimage_eq_of_subset]
  simp [range_val]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Ioi (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Ioi i = Ioo (i : ℕ) n := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Ioi_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, Ioi_inter_Iio]

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Iio (i : Fin n) : (↑) '' Iio i = Iio (i : ℕ) := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Iio_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact Iio_subset_Iio i.is_lt.le

@[simp]
theorem image_val_Icc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' Icc i j = Icc (i : ℕ) j := by
  rw [← preimage_val_Icc_val, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, range_val, inter_eq_left]
  exact fun k hk ↦ hk.2.trans_lt j.is_lt

@[simp] theorem image_val_uIcc (i j : Fin n) : (↑) '' uIcc i j = uIcc (i : ℕ) j := by simp [uIcc]

    simp [hi]
